api.description: Intersect Power is a U.S. digital-power infrastructure platform that develops co-located land, data-center shells, solar generation, battery storage and hybrid firming solutions for hyperscale cloud, AI and other energy-intensive customers. Google acquired the company on March 10, 2026 for US$4.75 billion, after making a minority investment in December 2024. The acquired company includes the Intersect team, digital-power business and specified co-located projects. Separate grid-tied operating and development assets were carved out into IPX Power and are not part of this PortCo. Former Intersect investors included Climate Adaptive Infrastructure, Greenbelt/Trilantic, TPG Rise Climate and Pantheon Infrastructure. Intersect reports a historical track record exceeding US$20 billion and 11.5 GW across 14 facilities, including legacy assets now assigned to IPX. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.

api.ownershipVehicle: PG Delta Holdco LLC; client infrastructure accounts
api.description: Dimension Energy LLC is a U.S. distributed-energy platform that develops, finances, owns and operates community solar, battery storage and localized power infrastructure. The platform serves households, businesses, utilities and large energy users across multiple U.S. markets and reported more than 600 MW operating or under construction, over US$2 billion invested and more than 35,000 subscribers by August 2026. Partners Group acquired control on June 24, 2021 through PG Delta Holdco LLC; FTC Solar sold its entire approximately 23% interest at closing. Dimension Renewable Energy is the former brand, while project LLCs, project joint ventures, lenders and tax-equity vehicles remain within or outside the platform boundary rather than separate PortCos. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
